title: Bare melody — every fret derived from pitch alone
description: Four quarter notes (sounding C3 D3 E3 F3) with no note-level fingerboard annotations: no string, no fret. The part declares standard strings[] — required, since no consumer assumes an instrument — and the renderer assigns each note the lowest playable fret: (5,3) (4,0) (4,2) (4,3). The headline case of the derivation ladder's bottom rung: any in-range score renders valid (if not necessarily ideally fingered) tab, and the assignment is presentation — nothing is written back to the document.
